claim: core/emit-html.ts hooks its box-sizing rule on the shared BEM prefix (`.<name>, .<name> *, …`), which no element carries in a MULTI-ROOT composite — each top-level root compiles to its own `.<name>__<root>` sibling class, descendant of nothing. The html surface therefore declares border-box for zero nodes on a multi-root contract. core/emit-react.ts does not share the defect: T013 (015, Phase 3) emits one rule per top-level root via topRoots(contract), because CSS Modules offer no shared prefix to hook a single rule onto.
retest: Re-tested mechanically on 2026-08-05 by the fixture that found it, evals/fixtures/react-box-model-border-box.ts. BEFORE the repair: emitHtml on a two-root synthetic contract yields 1 box-sizing declaration (hooked on a class no element carries), emitReact yields 2 (one per root) — the fixture's first run failed on exactly this asymmetry, which is what surfaced the defect. AFTER the repair (tinyspec select-option-emit, same day): the hardened fixture asserts the html multi-root leg (2 rules, selectors .box-model-multi__{root,trailer} — self + * + ::before/::after — property 1; counts 1 single-root / 2 two-root on BOTH surfaces, property 3) and runs green; it went RED first against the pre-repair emitter (archived in named-repair-DW-015-001.md).
impact: LATENT, not live: 0 of the 34 Piqueray contracts is multi-root (measured 2026-08-05, len(anatomy) > 1 across contracts/*.contract.json → 0). No shipped surface renders a wrong box because of it. The demo-51-era multi-root composites are archived and their eval cases quarantined.
fix: APPLIED by tinyspec select-option-emit (2026-08-05), exactly as predicted: componentCss() now emits one rule per root class via topRoots(contract) when isMultiRoot — emit-react's loop — with the single-root path byte-identical (build diff on src/ empty, golden.json's 213 hashes re-derived with an empty diff, Polaris --check byte-stable; the one real re-pin was the plugin engine receipt, whose bundle embeds the core barrel).
whyNotFixedHere: Out of 015's scope (US2/FR-004 targets the DELIVERED React surface, and emit-html was already correct for every existing contract), and an emitter edit in closure costs three re-pins — golden.json, the plugin engine receipt, and the Polaris showcase — to fix a defect that affects no contract. Belongs to whichever spec makes Piqueray multi-root, or to a dedicated engine pass.
